name: Stone Tokens
summary: At Tarren Mill, Keeper Bel'varil sends you to recover Stone Tokens from Dalaran agents in Alterac. The Forsaken seek to learn how Dalaran's mages bind and command elementals. Magus Voidglare studies those arcane methods for them.

sections.title: Arcane Subjugation
sections.body:
Dalaran's magi have long commanded elemental beings with specialized conduits and enchanted foci. They bind creatures from other dimensions and force them into servitude.

Though the city is still rebuilding, its agents and remnant forces patrol the surrounding territory. They use elementals as laborers and defensive shock troops. Magus Voidglare, an arcane researcher in Tarren Mill, works for the Forsaken and seeks to uncover the sorcery that compels these beings to obey.

sections.title: Inert Specimen Gathering
sections.body:
Keeper Bel'varil directs you to gather worn, faded tokens before seeking potent and volatile magical instruments. Dalaran personnel carry them around the outskirts and at the nearby internment camp.

Voidglare can study the lingering enchantments without risking uncontrolled planar backlash. These weathered tokens give him the basic theory he needs before he tests stronger means of binding.

faq.q: What are the stone tokens used for?
aliases: why do dalaran wizards have stone tokens
faq.answer: Dalaran's wizards craft and carry Stone Tokens as magical foci for commanding and subjugating elementals. They force creatures from other dimensions to serve as guards, sentries, and laborers.

faq.q: Why does Magus Voidglare want worn tokens specifically?
faq.answer: Worn Stone Tokens retain the foundational matrix of Dalaran's binding spells, though their active arcane power has faded. That makes them safer for Magus Voidglare to study without risking elemental retaliation or magical feedback.
Keeper Bel'varil is a Forsaken stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He helps Magus Voidglare by procuring magical artifacts and reagents from nearby territories.

faq.q: Where are the Dalaran forces holding these tokens?
faq.answer: Dalaran wizards and their personnel carry the tokens along the frontier between western Hillsbrad and the Alterac Mountains. They are found near Dalaran itself and the nearby ruins of the old orc internment camp.

faq.q: What happens after these tokens are delivered?
faq.answer: After Bel'varil inspects the inert specimens, Magus Voidglare advances from theory to physical containment. He commissions the procurement of heavier Bracers of Binding directly from the elementals.

faq.q: Why is the Horde studying Dalaran's magic?
faq.answer: The Forsaken see Dalaran's surviving mages as a territorial and magical threat in Lordaeron. By learning their methods, Forsaken spellcasters can counter Kirin Tor operations, protect their borders, and perhaps turn elemental forces to their own advantage.

angles.text: As a Mage, you know Dalaran's conjurers are renowned for binding elementals to their will. These tokens reveal how human magi tether extraplanar spirits to material foci.
As one of the Forsaken in Tarren Mill, you know that unraveling Dalaran's arcane secrets matters to Lordaeron's defense against human sorcerers just beyond its walls.
As a Shaman, you honor elementals through reciprocal pacts. Dalaran's wizards use arcane tokens to dominate and enslave them, against the way of spiritual harmony.
